title: M1. Границы источников
summary: Ввести typed source locator и zero-growth target boundaries, достаточные для badge-среза, не выдавая ложный PASS миграции всех legacy routes.
done_when: Every authored route resolves to exactly one Markdown source.
Badge resolves to content/ru/components/badge.md without prose dependencies.
New visible locale strings use content/<locale>/lang.json.
Public resources/i18n and site.json target inputs are rejected.
The finite legacy generated-route/prose inventory cannot grow.
